title: kairo_compile.json
description: The entry points of a Kairo project and the flags each is compiled with. Read by kals, the Kairo language server.

entries.description: One per entry point: the file `kairo` is given. Every other file is reached through imports, and belongs to the entry that imports it.

args.description: Every other argument, exactly as on the command line (for example "-I", "include/").

directory.description: Where the command runs, relative to this file. "." when omitted.

default_args.description: Flags for a file no entry reaches yet: it is checked as its own entry with these.
